## 背景
Phase A 训练产出的 checkpoint 是 FSDP 分片格式（world_size=2），Phase B 需要 HF 格式。之前 Worker 调研确认 veRL 内置 `python -m verl.model_merger merge --backend fsdp` 可用。

## Task A: 写 FSDP→HF 转换脚本

在服务器 bjb1-17606 (root) 上创建脚本 `/root/cost-verify-agent-rl/scripts/convert_fsdp_to_hf.sh`：

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# FSDP → HF checkpoint converter for Phase B
# Usage: ./convert_fsdp_to_hf.sh <fsdp_checkpoint_dir> <output_hf_dir>
# Example: ./convert_fsdp_to_hf.sh /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp012_grpo/global_step_30 /root/autodl-tmp/models/phase_a_hf

set -euo pipefail

FSDP_DIR=${1:?Usage: $0 <fsdp_dir> <hf_output_dir>}
HF_DIR=${2:?Usage: $0 <fsdp_dir> <hf_output_dir>}

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

echo "Converting FSDP checkpoint: $FSDP_DIR → $HF_DIR"
python -m verl.model_merger merge --backend fsdp --local_dir "$FSDP_DIR" --output_dir "$HF_DIR"

echo "Verifying output..."
python -c "
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained('$HF_DIR', trust_remote_code=True)
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('$HF_DIR', trust_remote_code=True)
print(f'Model loaded: {model.config.architectures}, params={sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())/1e6:.1f}M')
print('Conversion verified OK')
"
```

```bash

python -m verl.model_merger --help 2>/dev/null | head -10
```
